// Run from the repo root: node apply_navbar_redesign.js
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

const files = {
  "src/components/AppShell.tsx": "",
  "src/components/RetailOverview.tsx": "",
};

for (const [rel, b64] of Object.entries(files)) {
  const raw = Buffer.from(b64, 'base64').toString('utf8');
  const crlf = raw.replace(/\r\n/g, '\n').replace(/\n/g, '\r\n');
  const target = path.join(process.cwd(), rel);
  fs.writeFileSync(target, crlf, 'utf8');
  console.log('Wrote ' + rel + ' (' + crlf.length + ' chars)');
}
console.log('Done. Review with: git status / git diff --stat');
